purpose: Independent exact-source review evidence; no automatic scanner admission
candidate_kind: stable staged and working tree overlay
fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256(UTF8(path + NUL + SHA256(exact whole-file bytes) + NUL + RuleID + NUL + decimal StartLine))
scanner_scope: accepted manifest and staged/working candidate manifest only

findings.normalization: replace CRLF bytes with LF bytes, then SHA-256
findings.review_disposition: exact binding refresh of unchanged previously reviewed source metadata
